column3: requireActorActive (actor_active.go, #4159/#4546) reads only the acting user's own account row, not the activation or role-grant state RevokeBreakGlassActivationAtomic writes, so it is an actor-authority check. A stale pass equals revoke-then-suspend: suspension takes effect on the actor's next request, a legal serial order; the check only narrows what the function allowed before #4546, so it adds no race window. Covers this check only (the last-project-admin guard inside RevokeBreakGlassActivationAtomic runs under its own WithNamedLock and predates #4546).
